samuel1.28.p1.b1.text: Now in those days the Philistines gathered their forces for warfare against Israel.

samuel1.28.p1.b2.text: You must understand that you and your men are to go out to battle with me.

samuel1.28.p1.b3.text: Then you will come to know what your servant can do.

samuel1.28.p1.b4.text: I will make you my bodyguard for life.

samuel1.28.p2.b1.text: Now by this time Samuel had died, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, his own city.

samuel1.28.p2.b2.text: And Saul had removed the mediums and spiritists from the land.

samuel1.28.p2.b3.text: When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was afraid and trembled violently.

samuel1.28.p2.b4.text: He inquired of the LORD, but the LORD did not answer him by dreams or Urim or prophets.

samuel1.28.p3.b1.text: Find me a woman who is a medium, so I can go and consult her.

samuel1.28.p3.b2.text: There is a medium at Endor

samuel1.28.p3.b3.text: So Saul disguised himself by putting on different clothes, and he set out with two of his men. They came to the woman at night

samuel1.28.p3.b4.text: Consult a spirit for me. Bring up for me the one I name.

samuel1.28.p4.b1.text: Surely you know what Saul has done, how he has killed the mediums and spiritists in the land. Why have you set a trap to get me killed?

samuel1.28.p4.b2.text: As surely as the LORD lives, no punishment shall come upon you for this.

samuel1.28.p4.b3.text: Whom shall I bring up for you?

samuel1.28.p5.b1.text: Why have you deceived me? You are Saul!

samuel1.28.p5.b2.text: Do not be afraid…What do you see?

samuel1.28.p5.b3.text: I see a god coming up out of the earth

samuel1.28.p5.b4.text: An old man is coming up…And he is wearing a robe.

samuel1.28.p6.b1.text: Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up?

samuel1.28.p6.b2.text: I am deeply distressed…The Philistines are fighting against me, and God has turned away from me. He no longer answers me, either by prophets or by dreams.

samuel1.28.p6.b3.text: Why do you consult me…since the LORD has turned away from you and become your enemy?

samuel1.28.p6.b4.text: He has done exactly what He spoke through me: The LORD has torn the kingship out of your hand and given it to your neighbor David.

samuel1.28.p7.b1.text: Because you did not obey the LORD or carry out His burning anger against Amalek…

samuel1.28.p7.b2.text: Moreover, the LORD will deliver Israel with you into the hand of the Philistines

samuel1.28.p7.b3.text: tomorrow you and your sons will be with me…

samuel1.28.p7.b4.text: Immediately Saul fell flat on the ground…And his strength was gone, because he had not eaten anything all that day and night.

samuel1.28.p8.b1.text: Now please listen to your servant and let me set a morsel of bread before you so you may eat and have the strength to go on your way.

samuel1.28.p8.b3.text: The woman had a fattened calf at her house, and she quickly slaughtered it. She also took flour, kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread…

samuel1.28.p8.b4.text: She served it to Saul and his servants, and they ate. And that night they got up and left.
